title: Services
heading: Services
lead: Our comprehensive services for industrial and horticultural needs
body:
At Norhage Industri, we offer a wide variety of professional services tailored to meet the needs of businesses across multiple industries. From custom installations to product consultations and support, our expertise spans industrial, agricultural, and horticultural sectors. Whether you require specialized materials, system installations, or technical guidance, our dedicated team is ready to provide innovative and sustainable solutions that meet your exact requirements.

Explore our full range of services below, where you can learn more about each offering and how it can benefit your business.

Greenhouse Installation Services – Single-Span & Multi-Span

Enhance crop yields with professional greenhouse installation by Norhage Industri. We specialize in Single-Span and Multi-Span greenhouses, ensuring durable, energy-efficient, and climate-controlled structures for commercial growers, agriculture, and research. Get a custom installation tailored to your needs. Contact us today for expert solutions!

Greenhouse Repair and Restoration Services

Restore and optimize your greenhouse with our professional greenhouse repair services. From structural reinforcements to ventilation upgrades, we ensure durability, energy efficiency, and optimal growing conditions. Keep your greenhouse in top shape—discover our expert solutions today!

Terraces & Plastic Roofs Assembly Services

Enhance your outdoor space with our expert terrace and plastic roof assembly services. We provide durable, weather-resistant installations using high-quality materials like polycarbonate panels and aluminum frames. Perfect for residential and commercial projects, our solutions ensure lasting protection, style, and functionality. Contact us today for a seamless installation experience!

Horticulture System Project Calculation and Implementation

Our industrial projects calculation service provides accurate and detailed assessments for large-scale construction and installation projects. From materials estimation to structural analysis, we ensure that every aspect of your project is precisely calculated for maximum efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Trust our expertise to guide you from planning to completion with confidence.

PVC Strip Curtains Production

We provide high-quality PVC strip curtains designed for industrial use, offering durability and flexibility to suit a variety of environments. Our production process ensures that each curtain meets strict standards for temperature control, noise reduction, and space division, making them ideal for warehouses, workshops, and cold storage facilities. Custom sizes and configurations are available to meet your specific needs.

Aluminium & Plastic Cutting

Our aluminium and plastic cutting service provides precision cuts for a wide range of industrial applications. With advanced equipment and expert technicians, we ensure accurate and clean cuts tailored to your exact specifications. Whether for construction, manufacturing, or custom projects, we offer fast and reliable cutting solutions that meet the highest standards of quality.

Technical Plastic Materials Production

We specialize in the production of high-performance technical plastic materials designed for demanding industrial applications. Our expertise ensures that each product is manufactured with precision, durability, and flexibility to meet a wide range of specifications. From custom components to bulk production, we deliver reliable solutions tailored to your operational needs.
